reason: Keep a request-bound provider sample across admission, interruption and history changes so the context ring never alternates measured tokens with byte ceilings.
compatibility: Existing pressureTokens/projectedTokens semantics and durable events remain unchanged. lastMeasured is additive and optional; old private checkpoints default to no retained sample. Startup typed-log replay reconstructs it. No persisted sessions, calibration samples or admission limits are rewritten.
